title: 안 되면 또! 될 때까지!
titleT: If It Doesn't Work, Try Again — Until You Get It!

pages.ko: "안 되면 또! 될 때까지!" 놀이터에 온 콩이가 반짝반짝 새 줄넘기를 자랑해요. 손잡이가 알록달록, 폴짝 뛰면 참 멋질 것 같아요. 콩이는 벌써 신이 나서 볼주머니가 빵빵해요.
pages.t: "If it doesn't work, try again — until you get it!" Kongi came to the playground showing off a sparkly new jump rope. Its handles were colorful, and it looked like it would be so much fun to hop with. Kongi was already so excited that her cheek pouches puffed right up.

pages.ko: "이얍!" 콩이가 줄을 넘겼는데— 발에 탁! 걸렸어요. 다시 이얍! 또 탁! 줄이 자꾸만 발에 감겨요. "어? 왜 안 되지?" 콩이 얼굴이 발그레해졌어요.
pages.t: "Hup!" Kongi tried to jump the rope, but it caught on her foot — thwack! She tried again — hup! Thwack, again! The rope kept tangling around her feet. "Huh? Why can't I do it?" Kongi's face turned pink.

pages.ko: 열 번을 뛰어도 열 번 다 걸렸어요. 콩이는 줄넘기를 툭 내려놓고 쭈그려 앉았어요. "난 못 해… 나만 안 돼." 눈에 눈물이 그렁그렁 맺혔어요.
pages.t: She tried ten times, and all ten times it caught. Kongi dropped the jump rope and sat down, crouching. "I can't do it… I'm the only one who can't." Tears welled up in her eyes.

pages.ko: 그때 호리와 토토가 조르르 달려왔어요. "콩아, 처음엔 다 그래!" 호리가 어깨를 톡톡, 토토가 손을 쑥 내밀어요. "안 되면 또 하면 되지! 될 때까지!"
pages.t: Just then, Hori and Toto came running over. "Kongi, everyone's like that at first!" Hori patted her shoulder gently, and Toto held out his hand. "If it doesn't work, just try again — until you get it!"

pages.ko: 토토가 살짝 알려줬어요. "줄이 발 앞에 올 때 콩! 뛰는 거야." 호리도 옆에서 손뼉을 쳐요. "하나, 둘— 박자에 맞춰서!" 콩이 귀가 쫑긋 섰어요.
pages.t: Toto gave her a little tip. "Jump right when the rope comes in front of your feet — boing!" Hori clapped along beside her. "One, two — keep the rhythm!" Kongi's ears perked right up.

pages.ko: 콩이가 다시 줄을 돌렸어요. 하나— 콩! 어? 한 번 넘었어요! 딱 한 번이었지만 걸리지 않았어요. "됐다! 한 번 넘었어!" 친구들이 와아— 손뼉을 쳐요. 안 되면 또! 될 때까지!
pages.t: Kongi swung the rope again. One — boing! Huh? She jumped it! It was only once, but it didn't catch. "I did it! I jumped one time!" Her friends clapped and cheered. If it doesn't work, try again — until you get it!

pages.ko: 두 번째는 또 탁! 걸렸어요. 하지만 콩이는 이제 울지 않아요. "괜찮아, 안 되면 또!" 줄을 툭툭 털고 다시 섰어요. 하나, 둘— 세 번! 콩이가 조금씩 늘어가요.
pages.t: The second try caught again — thwack! But Kongi didn't cry this time. "It's okay, if it doesn't work, I'll just try again!" She shook out the rope and stood up straight. One, two — three jumps! Kongi was getting a little better each time.

pages.ko: 폴짝, 폴짝, 폴짝! 이제 콩이가 안 걸리고 쭉쭉 넘어요. 다섯 번, 여섯 번, 일곱 번! 그 순간 콩이 복슬 꼬리가 무지개색으로 반짝— 반짝! 콩이가 해냈어요!
pages.t: Hop, hop, hop! Now Kongi jumped without catching, again and again. Five times, six times, seven times! At that moment, Kongi's fluffy tail sparkled in rainbow colors! Kongi did it!

pages.ko: 셋이 손을 모으고 약속했어요. 하나, 처음엔 안 돼도 괜찮아. 둘, 안 되면 또 하면 돼. 셋, 될 때까지 조금씩! 콩이가 씩씩하게 외쳐요. "다음엔 열 번도 넘을 거야!"
pages.t: The three friends put their hands together and made a promise. One, it's okay if you can't do it at first. Two, if it doesn't work, just try again. Three, keep going little by little until you get it! Kongi shouted bravely. "Next time, I'll jump ten times!"

pages.ko: 호리와 토토가 콩이를 꼭 안아 주었어요. "안 걸리고 넘는 콩이, 정말 멋져!" 이제 콩이는 알아요. 한 번에 안 돼도 다시 하면 조금씩 는다는 걸. 안 되면 또! 될 때까지!
pages.t: Hori and Toto gave Kongi a big hug. "Kongi jumping without catching — that's so amazing!" Now Kongi knows. Even if you can't do it right away, trying again will help you get a little better each time. If it doesn't work, try again — until you get it!
